backend.reason: The frozen repository-promotion status has no product backend meaning and must not create an Opsia API contract.

frontend.reason: The frozen upstream repository prompt is intentionally excluded from product UI by the enforced product-name boundary.

backend.reason: Star and dismiss mutations belong only to the frozen upstream repository promotion prompt and must not be exposed by the Python gateway.

frontend.reason: The product deliberately omits upstream repository promotion actions while retaining legal provenance only in the isolated reference and root notice.

backend.reason: External URL opening is local desktop authority; the Python gateway and target agents must never receive or execute it.

desktop.reason: The foundation permits only opaque handles issued by native save; arbitrary workstation paths from a server response are intentionally prohibited.
No signed desktop release manifest, updater keys or updater command are configured; the visible native menu item is disabled.

backend.reason: The typed RBAC and bounded scan boundary is implemented, but no persisted provider-backed rightsizing observation repository is connected.

frontend.reason: The workload strip and explicit multi-cluster Cost scan surface render the strict observed-or-unavailable union; production remains unavailable until the collector repository supplies evidence.

backend.reason: Local shell authority and credentials stay on the desktop device; the Python gateway and target agents must never proxy this session.
An active local listener registry is workstation authority and must never be synthesized by the Python gateway.

desktop.reason: No Tauri local-port registry or window-owned session list exists, so Opsia cannot claim active native forward sessions.
Exact Service port discovery and a manual loopback command are safe browser capabilities; only ownership of the listener requires Tauri.

backend.reason: Python validates the portable request shape but must never own a workstation listener.

desktop.reason: A typed Tauri start command, native listener/process registry, capacity policy, and ownership receipt are not implemented.

backend.reason: Stopping or replacing a workstation listener is native desktop authority and must not traverse the gateway.

desktop.reason: No native forward session ID, stop command, or generation-safe recreate contract exists.
The HTTP request executes inside the target cluster agent and is consumed through the authenticated browser command stream; no workstation authority is needed.
